Info Security Controls Specialist II B

Hyderabad Telangana, North Carolina, United States
Acknowledge

Job Description:

The individual will be part of Privileged Access Management Services team. The role will support the IAM/PAM team by strengthening privileged access security through vulnerability remediation, privileged access solution design, and standards enforcement aligned with least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, solution, and remediate active directory IAM vulnerabilities.

  • Develop, configure, integrate and deliver solutions to improve the privileged access posture of the company.

  • Design and solution IAM-PAM compliance platform to identify control defects, assign remediation, measure and report on risk posture improvement

  • Define and enforce standards for multi-layered privileged access management defense plan.

Requirements

Education

BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)

Experience Range

8+ Years

Foundational skills

  • Hands-on experience administering privileged access management and understanding of active directory. (CyberArk, HashiVault, PowerBroker)

  • Strong understanding of authentication and access control standards and technologies. (oAuth, OIDC, SAML, MFA, certificates)

  • 3 years of cloud experience and practical knowledge of Azure, AWS (IAM, PermissionSets, SWS).
